title: Israel’s Election Is Unlikely to Change Its Policies and Global Isolation
summary_full: The leading contenders, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot, aren’t substantially different in their approach to Israel’s security or in their opposition to a Palestinian state.
